policy.unit_rule: Only exact units or an explicitly listed same-analyte conversion may be compared. Incompatible or unqualified units return unknown.
policy.caution: Reference intervals vary by laboratory, population, specimen, method, age, sex, pregnancy status, and clinical purpose. These data are for benchmark normalization and research, not patient care.
policy.legacy_note: Entries whose source IDs do not end in _2026 were already present in the frozen catalog and are retained for backward compatibility. The 2026 extension does not claim to have re-derived those legacy limits.

datasets.exclusion_reason: Public records contain HPO phenotype identifiers and disease identifiers, not raw numeric laboratory results.

limitations: This is a conservative regex and alias audit, not a clinical NLP gold standard; prose-only and unusually formatted measurements may be missed.
An unsupported unit can be a dataset extraction error, a method-specific unit, or a missing conversion; it is never numerically compared by the runtime.
Tumor markers, high-sensitivity troponin, D-dimer, reproductive hormones, and NT-proBNP require method or clinical context even when representative limits are listed.
Raw benchmark files are checksum-verified locally and are not redistributed by this repository.
